europe_now.title: Drone Attack Damages Ship in Gulf of Finland
europe_now.summary: A Russia-bound cargo vessel sustained damage from a drone strike in the Gulf of Finland. Both Finnish and Russian authorities acknowledged the maritime security incident.

europe_now.title: EU Budget Proposal Sparks Debate Over Spending Cuts
europe_now.summary: A newly introduced EU budget framework featuring proposed spending reductions has generated sharp divisions between different member state factions. The planned financial adjustments precede an upcoming crunch summit.

top_stories.title: Gulf of Finland Maritime Incident
top_stories.summary: A drone strike damaged a cargo vessel operating in the Gulf of Finland. Officials from multiple nations confirmed the security breach involving the Russia-bound ship.

top_stories.title: Demonstrations Across France
top_stories.summary: Protests and social unrest continued across France as the movement entered its sixth consecutive week. Turnout for the latest demonstrations showed a decline compared to previous weeks.
